newsitem.title: CHINA: China Daqing to maintain 50 mln T/yr oil output.
newsitem.headline: China Daqing to maintain 50 mln T/yr oil output.

text.p: China's big northeastern Daqing oilfield expects to maintain its annual crude oil output at 50 million tonnes for the next 15 years, the China Economic Times said on Wednesday.
The newspaper quoted Ding Minggui, director general of the Daqing Oilfield Administration, as making the remarks at a recent seminar in the capital.
Daqing, the nation's biggest oilfield and one of its oldest, has topped that level since 1976.
The field accounts for 47 percent of nation's total onshore crude oil output, he was quoted as saying.

He gave no details of how Daqing would maintain that level for so long a period but the oilfield's administrators have been relying on more expensive tertiary recovery methods to extract more oil from old wells.
